quarterly_data.signal: Government program (translated from Japanese): a five-company consortium led by Sumitomo Osaka Cement (with Takuma, Iwatani, Omnia Concerto and Taisei) was selected for the Tokyo Metropolitan Government's FY2026 feasibility study on building a CO2 supply chain, to study capturing and using CO2 emitted by Tokyo waste-incineration plants via artificial limestone, high-purity CO2 and bio routes; technical, economic, LCA and regulatory evaluation runs over FY2026-FY2027.
